headline: Expanse Line Firms as Mooring County and Nevish Line Burn
war_summary: Fighting has shifted since the last edition. The Weathered Expanse, where the Warden hold had thinned, is firmed again at six works of nine against one Colonial and two unclaimed; fifty-seven events were logged there in twenty-four hours, with the day's heaviest toll at 9,810 Colonial and 12,941 Warden casualties, though the hourly rate is falling. At Nevish Line the Wardens now lead five works to three, the line having stood level at the previous filing, and five events fell within the last two hours. Mooring County is the newest furnace: two events in the past two hours, the latest stamped at this edition's cutoff, 4,818 Colonial and 3,924 Warden casualties over the day, and a count of nine Warden works, two Colonial and one unclaimed. Callahan's Passage holds at nine works to one, its fire cooled to 187 casualties an hour on each side from 288 and 287 the hour before. Kuura Strand has gone quiet again after twenty-one events in the day. Across 436 counted works the Colonials hold 312, the Wardens 119, and five lie unclaimed. No victory is declared on this, the 535th day; thirty-four towns remain the mark.
